title: Fish Keeper
subtitle: Read-only audit and protection for your fish.
status.truncated: Only the most recent records are indexed.
overview.emptyBody: Add a data source in the plugin configuration, then refresh.
overview.sourceError: This source could not be read.
overview.protection: Protection starts when the console first runs.

timeline.truncated: Some sources exceeded the scan limit; narrow the filters.

checkpoints.title: Checkpoints
checkpoints.empty: No checkpoints yet. They are created when a tracked file changes.
checkpoints.createHint: Create a checkpoint before editing persona or memory files.
checkpoints.restoreWarning: Restore writes the selected files back to their recorded before-state. The event stream is never rewritten.
checkpoints.staleWarning: These files changed after the checkpoint. Restoring will discard the newer content unless you explicitly allow it.
checkpoints.restoreConfirm: I understand and want to restore these files
checkpoints.unsupported: This source does not support restore; checkpoints are for audit and migration only.
checkpoints.noDiff: No text diff was stored for this file.
checkpoints.safety: A safety checkpoint was created first.
checkpoints.select: Select a checkpoint to inspect it.
doctor.title: Environment check
doctor.refreshHint: Checks are read-only. Nothing is installed or modified.
doctor.evidence.windowsAcl: Windows ACLs are not interpreted by this check.
doctor.evidence.sourceWritable: {path} is writable by the current user.
doctor.evidence.sourceNotWritable: {path} is not writable by the current user.
doctor.evidence.credentialWindows: Present (Windows ACLs are not interpreted by this check).
doctor.evidence.profileNoEnv: DSH_PROFILE_DIR is not set; cannot inspect the profile manifest.
doctor.evidence.profileNoBundles: No dsh.profile.bundles list was found in the profile manifest.
doctor.evidence.profileNoFish: No known fish plugin is declared in this profile.
doctor.evidence.profileEntryOk: {name} is in both dependencies and profile bundles.
doctor.evidence.profileEntryDepOnly: {name} is in dependencies but not in profile bundles.
doctor.evidence.profileEntryBundleOnly: {name} is in profile bundles but not in dependencies.
doctor.evidence.profileEntryNeither: {name} is in neither dependencies nor profile bundles.
doctor.evidence.pluginsUnavailable: pluginInventory is not available in this profile.
doctor.evidence.binaryUnavailable: The subprocess service is not available.
doctor.evidence.lockWriter: This instance owns the source locks.
doctor.evidence.lockReadOnly: This instance is read-only because another instance owns at least one source lock.
doctor.remediation.storeMissing: Restart the plugin; it creates the directory on start.
doctor.remediation.storePermissions: Fix ownership or permissions of the data root.
doctor.remediation.windowsAcl: Review the folder ACL manually if other users share this machine.
doctor.remediation.sourceInitFailed: Check the path and permissions in the plugin configuration.
doctor.remediation.sourceMissing: Fix the data source location or disable the source.
doctor.remediation.sourceWritable: Fix ownership or permissions of the data directory.
doctor.remediation.credentialMissing: Create the channel credential file or update the configured path.
doctor.remediation.credentialBroad: Run chmod 600 on the credential file.
doctor.remediation.sourceRead: Check that the data source is reachable and its format is supported.
doctor.remediation.profileBundles: Update the profile manifest or ignore this check on this DSH version.
doctor.remediation.profileEntry: Add the package to both the profile dependencies and dsh.profile.bundles so the next install keeps it.
doctor.remediation.binary: Install ffmpeg only if the fish plugin needs media processing.
doctor.remediation.lock: Close the other console instance or accept read-only mode.
migration.title: Migration
migration.exportHint: Full mode copies tracked data. Share mode omits diary text, memory text, credentials, and checkpoint blobs.
migration.importHint: Paste the absolute path of a .fishkeeper package. Reference import extracts into the console data root only and never writes fish plugin data.
migration.writeHint: Write-back backs up the target fish.json, creates a safety checkpoint, then replaces the file atomically. Reload dsh-fishtank afterwards so its in-memory state does not overwrite the import.
migration.noWriteTargets: No file source supports write-back. Set preset to fishtank or options.allowImport: true under Sources first.
migration.overwriteConfirm: The target already holds data; overwrite it (a backup is kept)
migration.referenceOverwriteConfirm: A reference copy with the same id already exists; overwrite it
migration.writeNote: Reload dsh-fishtank before inspecting the result; the backup is kept next to the imports directory.
migration.referenceNote: Reference-only import does not modify any fish plugin data directory.
settings.title: Data sources
settings.dataRootHint: Relative paths resolve against the plugin package root; leave empty for ~/.dsh/fishkeeper. Saving reloads the plugin.
settings.rulesHint: Enable/disable rules, change severity, or add keyword/regex rules. Regexes are validated before saving; rules run locally only.
settings.rulesEmpty: No rules. Use "Add rule" to create one.
settings.autoCheckpointsHint: Only selected file roles create automatic checkpoints; manual checkpoints are unaffected.
settings.hint: Add, edit, or remove data sources. Saving reloads the plugin; changing an id leaves existing checkpoints under the old id.
settings.reloadHint: The plugin is reloading. If the panel does not refresh automatically, retry in a moment.
settings.empty: No sources yet. Click "Add source" to start.
settings.optionsHint: File sources accept fieldMap; HTTP sources accept credentialKey, statusPath, allowRemote, and so on.
settings.invalidOptions: Advanced options must be a JSON object.
settings.writeBackHint: Write-back is available only for file sources with preset=fishtank or options.allowImport: true. HTTP sources never participate in write-back.
error.title: Request failed
error.generic: Something went wrong. Check the Host log for details.
error.network: Cannot reach the Host. Refresh the page and try again.
error.notReady: The console is still starting. Try again in a moment.
error.doctor: Could not run the environment check.
warning.fishtank-embedded: dsh-fishtank keeps every field in fish.json; automatic checkpoints for diary, persona, and memory files are disabled for this preset.
warning.fishtank-running: dsh-fishtank holds state in memory and saves with a debounce, so an external write to fish.json can be overwritten. Reload the fish plugin after import or restore.
warning.dshfish-readonly: dsh-fish sources are read-only here: diary/*.md, events.jsonl, and home.json are never written, imported, or restored.
warning.dshfish-append-only: events.jsonl is the append-only source of truth; checkpoints record its hash only, because this preset declares no restorable files.
warning.http-remote: Remote HTTP sources are enabled explicitly.
warning.fishtank-http: dsh-fishtank exposes only /fishtank/state and /fishtank/talk; there is no diary or external-event route, so HTTP mode reads the last 3 diary entries from /fishtank/state.
warning.fishtank-credential: A credential reference is configured ({key}); it must resolve to an api-key record.
warning.fishtank-unauthenticated: dsh-fishtank routes are unauthenticated today; configure options.credentialKey if a gateway adds auth.
error.code.internal: Internal error. Check the Host log for details.
error.code.source-not-found: This data source was not found.
error.code.source-unreadable: The data source could not be read. Check its path, permissions, and format.
error.code.source-invalid: The data source configuration or data format is invalid.
error.code.source-unauthorized: The data source rejected the credential, or no credential is available.
error.code.lock-held: Another console instance owns this source; this instance is read-only.
error.code.confirm-invalid: The confirmation expired or is invalid; run the preflight again.
error.code.checkpoints-unsupported: This source does not support checkpoints.
error.code.restore-unsupported: This checkpoint has no restorable files.
error.code.restore-stale: Files changed after the checkpoint; confirm the overwrite first.
error.code.import-incompatible: The package did not pass preflight.
error.code.import-overwrite-required: The target already holds data; confirm the overwrite first.
error.code.import-unsafe: The import package contains unsafe entries.
error.code.config-unavailable: This Host cannot edit configuration; edit cordis.patch.yml instead.
error.code.bad-request: The request is missing parameters or malformed.
